Media fixtures contain no user data. `red-square.mp4` is one 64 × 64 red frame generated with FFmpeg's color source (H.264, no audio). `media-phrase.wav` is the macOS Samantha voice saying “Media fixture test.”, resampled to 16 kHz mono PCM. They exercise real AVFoundation and on-device Speech extraction without network calls or an AI API credential. PNG and PDF fixtures are constructed directly in the tests.
